objectives: Solve the AsyncIO Tasks and TaskGroups exercises without looking at the lesson
Test edge cases and explain your approach

sections.title: Exercises
sections.body:
### Exercise 1: Task Monitor

Create a task monitor that:

1. Tracks all created tasks
2. Reports status every second
3. Logs when tasks complete/fail
4. Provides summary at end

### Exercise 2: Rate Limiter

Create a rate-limited task runner:

1. Max N tasks per second
2. Queue for pending tasks
3. Fair scheduling

### Exercise 3: Supervised Tasks

Create a supervisor pattern:

1. Restart failed tasks automatically
2. Max restart count per task
3. Backoff on repeated failures

### Exercise 4: Task Cancellation Chain

Create a task hierarchy:

1. Parent task spawns child tasks
2. Cancelling parent cancels all children
3. Child failure reports to parent

### Exercise 5: Deadline Scheduler

Create a deadline-based scheduler:

1. Tasks have deadlines
2. Automatically cancel past deadline
3. Priority based on deadline proximity

### Exercise 6: Task Pool

Implement a fixed-size task pool:

1. Max N concurrent tasks
2. Queue for pending
3. Return results in order

### Exercise 7: Circuit Breaker

Implement async circuit breaker:

1. Track failure count
2. Open circuit after N failures
3. Half-open after timeout
4. Reset on success

### Exercise 8: Task Dependency Graph

Create a dependency executor:

1. Tasks specify dependencies
2. Run in correct order
3. Parallelize independent tasks

### Exercise 9: Progress Reporter

Create a progress system:

1. Tasks report progress
2. Aggregate total progress
3. Estimate time remaining

### Exercise 10: Task Serialization

Create serializable tasks:

1. Save task state to JSON
2. Restore and resume
3. Handle partial completion
